title: Payment gateway 504 gateway timeout
description: Checkout transactions are timing out after 30 seconds when attempting to reach the payment processor.

hypotheses.name: Incorrect payment endpoint
hypotheses.description: The service is configured with an invalid payment gateway URL.
hypotheses.recommended_action: Verify application endpoint environment variables against API specification.

hypotheses.name: Payment provider outage
hypotheses.description: The external payment processor is experiencing an outage or high latency.
hypotheses.recommended_action: Check provider status page, enable automatic circuit breaker failover to secondary processor, and alert on-call payments lead.

hypotheses.name: Database failure
hypotheses.description: Database locks or slow queries are blocking payment processing threads.
hypotheses.recommended_action: Inspect active transactions in database and terminate orphaned locks.

evidence.observation: No deployments or configuration changes in the last 48 hours.
High rate of HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout errors when invoking external provider API.
PostgreSQL replication lag is 0s, CPU utilization is 12%.
